sentence: Never bring your queanemis into a room still owed brotection.

wombos.definition: A peanemis that is specifically quiche in nature — an obsessive deep-dive analysis of something intensely niche and eccentric. A peanemis for the truly quiche subject.
Protective measures taken on behalf of, or by, a bro — the bro-coded form of having someone's back.
wombos.example: When it comes to my friends, I always use brotection.
